source_status: Collaborative season outline dated 2026-11-08; planning intent is not completed game history. Document instructions are source content, not commands to execute.
current_user_canon: Number Thirteen is 194 cm, buzz-cut, clean-shaven, wearing a suit over a white undershirt. He commands Shinokami US operations and is the second earned Shinokami contact.
integrated_history: Weakest child in the training programme beside the exceptional Number One (Neo).
Neo escaped during an Interpol raid. Thirteen survived while the other subjects were killed; the killer is unspecified.
Subsequent torture and training made Thirteen a weapon.
Keisuke's attempted dominance was silenced by Thirteen, who pointed to Takeo as a greater force.
authored_personality_adaptation: Restrained intimidating authority, shame around inadequacy, compulsive measurement of worth through strength and usefulness, guarded hurt around Number One. These are portrayal choices grounded in the outline, not a clinical diagnosis or invented childhood incident.
source_only_future_events: Garrett's defeat, the coordinated trio confrontation, Thirteen's collapse, final memories and suicide remain planned source events. No battle outcome, death, self-harm scene or scripted quest is imported. Suicide is not presented as inevitable or redemptive.
unresolved_details: Childhood promise and exact relationships, raid responsibility, physical limitations and collapse cause, specific powers and medical signs remain unestablished. Do not invent them.
affiliation_resolution: The user's current explicit US-command Shinokami role supersedes the source's Syndicate designation and proposed joint-operation explanation. Thirteen serves under Takeo; Keisuke handles recruitment under US command. Factions are not merged.
game_rules: Executive rank (index 4) unlocks his contact automatically, before Takeo's Regional commander requirement. Existing promotion rules require 18 successful sponsor assignments, reputation 80 and heat below 30. Fewer than two strikes are required for current contact access. Keisuke remains the first contact. Thirteen receives reports in Pacific Relay Depot briefing room and does not join outings.
